objective.text: Use strict value comparison when loose collection matching would merge identifiers of different types.

difficulty.rationale: Keep identifiers whose type is part of the contract from being collapsed by loose matching.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: The identifiers 7 and "7" are intentionally distinct in this input contract. Which collection operation removes exact duplicates while retaining both typed identifiers?

options.rationale: Converting both to integers also erases the distinction before strict comparison.
options.misconception: Converting both to integers also erases the distinction before strict comparison.

options.rationale: Converting both values to strings erases the type distinction before deduplication.
options.misconception: Converting both values to strings erases the type distinction before deduplication.

options.rationale: Default loose uniqueness can collapse the integer and numeric string into one value.
options.misconception: Default loose uniqueness can collapse the integer and numeric string into one value.

options.rationale: Strict uniqueness keeps integer 7 distinct from string "7"; values only reindexes the result.

explanation.summary: Strict uniqueness keeps integer 7 distinct from string "7"; values only reindexes the result.
